November 08, 2022

MELISSA conference 2022

📍 Conference: MELISSA

🗓 Date/Location: 08-10 November 2022, Toulouse

Rethinking Waste as a Resource (Part 2)

After our first presentation exploring using menstrual blood as a resource, we presented the same message but this time to the MELISSA audience, specifically tailored to the regenerative life support systems for long term space missions by the European Space Agency.
